question: Jim Thorpe's 1912 Olympic titles were restored in 1982. Why did the IOC rule on his case again in 2022?
answer: Because 1982 made him only a co-champion. Stripped in 1913 for having been paid to play minor-league baseball, he was reinstated alongside the athletes promoted into his places. In July 2022 the IOC listed him as the sole winner of the pentathlon and decathlon, 69 years after his death.
